note: Small SRA on Memphis Lake, a 48-acre no-wake lake ~20 mi W of Omaha. NGPC's site inventory shows 18 Electric Plus sites (54-72) north of the shore rows and 60 basic sites, plus primitive camping; basic sites 1-10 line the east shore. Water, primitive toilets, playground, dump/fill station. Self-pay iron ranger (cash or check). --Claude
